title: EduBench: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models in Diverse Educational Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise comparisons where response-generation models act as evaluators to assess datasets containing their own generated responses, measuring if a model disproportionately prefers its own outputs.

Comparing pairwise evaluation outcomes from different types of evaluator models (reasoning models vs. general-purpose normal models) to assess if evaluators exhibit systematic preferences toward responses generated by models of their same type.

Presenting randomly sampled response pairs to LLM evaluators in both their original and reversed order to measure if the evaluator systematically favors the first (former) or second (latter) response presented.
